name: USB & Serial Attribution
description: Sysfs ownership mapping plus bounded receive and confirmed transmit/receive sessions for reviewed general-purpose USB serial nodes.
help_text: Inspection remains read-only. Bounded socat sessions expose live non-reserved device selection, baud/data/parity/stop/flow settings, receive artifacts, and target-bound confirmation for transmit. EC25 modem nodes remain MODEM RESERVED. A continuous interactive terminal would require an authenticated PTY streaming transport and is not represented by one-shot jobs.
